questions.text: Which two technological developments are considered key drivers of modern globalisation?
options: Steam locomotives and printed daily newspapers
Transport technology (bulk carriers and container ships) and communications technology (Internet and email)
Exclusively airmail and local craft workshops
National tariff barriers and paper archives
questions.correctAnswer: Transport technology (bulk carriers and container ships) and communications technology (Internet and email)

questions.text: Rauch Fruit Juices buys orange juice concentrate in Brazil, produces Happy Day in Austria, and sells the juice to Qatar. Which roles does Rauch perform?
options: Exporter toward Brazil and importer toward Qatar
Exclusively an importer in both countries
Importer toward Brazil and exporter toward Qatar
Exclusively an exporter in both countries
questions.correctAnswer: Importer toward Brazil and exporter toward Qatar

questions.text: Which example illustrates a strong international brand image as a cause of foreign trade?
options: Coffee from Brazil and crude oil from the North Sea
Domestic cheese surplus from Holland
Ski manufacturing specialization in Austria
Swarovski and Red Bull

questions.text: According to WKO data, what was Austria's export volume in 2024 and how many companies export from Austria?
options: EUR 203 billion export volume with more than 63,000 exporting companies
EUR 63 billion export volume with around 20,000 exporting companies
EUR 450 billion export volume with fewer than 10,000 exporting companies
EUR 120 billion export volume with exactly 100,000 exporting companies
questions.correctAnswer: EUR 203 billion export volume with more than 63,000 exporting companies

questions.text: Which four countries are Austria's main export trading partners?
options: France, Spain, Brazil, and Qatar
Germany, the USA, Italy, and Switzerland
China, Japan, Poland, and Sweden
Hungary, Greece, Portugal, and Canada
questions.correctAnswer: Germany, the USA, Italy, and Switzerland

questions.text: Which typical disadvantage of globalisation affects developing countries in particular?
options: Offshoring of high-paid domestic research centers
Excessively high import prices for domestic commodities
Labor exploitation, environmental pollution, profit outflow to TNCs, and brain drain
Loss of the ability to attract foreign direct investment
questions.correctAnswer: Labor exploitation, environmental pollution, profit outflow to TNCs, and brain drain

questions.text: What does the export ratio measure for a country or a company?
options: The exported share of a country's GDP or a company's output
The number of countries from which a company imports commodities
The difference between the exchange rate and import customs duties
The percentage of foreign staff employed by a corporation
questions.correctAnswer: The exported share of a country's GDP or a company's output

questions.text: Long-distance trade is not purely a modern phenomenon, as illustrated by the Silk Road linking China and Europe in the Middle Ages.
Transnational Corporations (TNCs) operate solely inside their home country so that their decisions do not affect people in other nations.
Why is foreign trade essential for Austria's economy? Include key figures and name two challenges companies face when going international.
questions.correctAnswer: Austria has a small domestic market and limited natural resources. Over 63,000 companies export EUR 203 billion (2024) to 200+ countries (main partners: Germany, USA, Italy, Switzerland; key sectors: mechanical engineering, chemicals, vehicles, steel/metal goods, food/beverages), securing jobs and prosperity. Going international challenges include language barriers, cultural differences, unfamiliar legal systems, exchange rate volatility, long transport routes and customs, political instability, and local competition.
